BERA.name: TriggerChannel
BERA.tooltip: ActiCHamp input the trigger cable is plugged into, counted over all amplifier inputs: 1-32 are the EEG inputs, 33 = AUX 1, 34 = AUX 2, and so on. It does not depend on how many EEG channels you record: trigger in AUX 1 -> enter 33. This is not the column number in the saved file (there the trigger follows the recorded EEG channels).

BERA.name: LivePlotCH
BERA.tooltip: Of which Channel do you want a live plot?

BERA.name: ChannelIpsi
BERA.tooltip: Use 1; Channel number of the stimulation side (ipsilateral)

BERA.name: ChannelContra
BERA.tooltip: Use 2, or 1 if not needed; Channel number of the not stimulated side (contralateral)

BERA.name: StimFreq
BERA.tooltip: Frequency / Hz; Stimulation Frequency; E.g. every 100ms is one click stimulus

BERA.name: dB_SPL
BERA.tooltip: What is the level of stimulation in dB SPL
